verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials describe the full flow: a vendor invoice is dragged in, matched to its PO, coded to GL, routed for approval and paid (ramp-docs-2). This is backed by dynamic approval routing (ramp-docs-16), a bill-payments API with document attachment and vendor payment (ramp-docs-23), and CLI bill draft/pending/approve commands. The approval routing is also referenced in the AI-agents guide (bill approvals in the UI or the Approvals API) and in webhook events for bill approvals. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on configuring multi-step bill approval chains, independent or hands-on corroboration of the bill upload-to-approval-to-payment flow.
